method: Matched every keep decision by the review tool content-hash algorithm. Compared complete statements and operational models with active catalog records. Read load-bearing primary-source text and checked subsequent progress. No review or service-acceptance decision was fabricated.

problems.title: Asymptotic nonclassical-state conversion by linear optics
problems.summary: The linear-optical protocol class is fixed explicitly. Known achievable rates and monotone converses do not determine arbitrary conversions.

problems.title: Single-seed post-processing of Gaussian POVM densities
problems.summary: A randomized choice of two pure seeds with different covariances disproves the universal single-seed representation. The direct proof is identified as editorial.

problems.title: Optimal output monitoring for parametric-oscillator squeezing
problems.summary: A published homodyne solution and a direct uncertainty/total-variance bound coincide for the stated fixed-quadrature mean cost.

problems.title: Gaussian optimality of two-mode entanglement of formation
problems.summary: The August 2026 Adesso preprint proves Gaussian optimality for arbitrary finite-energy two-mode Gaussian states. Preprint status is explicit; the existing multimode question is distinct.

problems.title: Additivity of entanglement of formation for two-mode Gaussian states
problems.summary: Single-copy Gaussian optimality does not establish tensor-power additivity. The regularized entanglement-cost relation and remaining gap are separated.

problems.title: Two-way distillable entanglement of mixed two-mode Gaussian states
problems.summary: Nonpositive partial transpose ensures distillability in this Gaussian family, but known bounds do not determine the rate for arbitrary mixed inputs.

problems.title: LOCC entanglement cost of PPT-entangled Gaussian states
problems.summary: Positive-partial-transpose Gaussian entanglement is nondistillable, but its unrestricted LOCC preparation cost is a different unresolved quantity.

problems.title: Exact covariance criterion for bipartite Gaussian separability
problems.summary: The covariance domination criterion is necessary and sufficient. The record states the full matrix-feasibility condition and its scope.

problems.title: Bounded witnesses for every continuous-variable entangled state
problems.summary: Closed-convex-set separation supplies a bounded witness for every entangled state, including positive-partial-transpose states.

problems.title: Optimal success probability for Gaussian processing of non-Gaussian entanglement
problems.summary: A concrete heralded protocol supplies probability-versus-error lower bounds. Convergence is distinguished from optimal success probability and positive asymptotic yield.

problems.title: Gaussian entanglement of formation beyond bisymmetry
problems.summary: Gaussian purification and the Koashi–Winter relation identify the universal discord question with the existing Gaussian entanglement-of-formation question. The canonical record receives the alternate formulation.

problems.title: Entropy photon-number inequality
problems.summary: The quantum entropy power inequality and thermal-port subcases do not settle the two-arbitrary-input entropy photon-number inequality.

problems.title: Low-energy Holevo additivity for a squeezed thermal attenuator
problems.summary: The energy threshold and entanglement-breaking subcase are stated. The 2026 one-use Gaussian-optimality preprint does not prove block additivity.

problems.title: Gaussian-measurement equality with the Holevo bound
problems.summary: An exact finite optimization for the Holevo bound is known. Equality with the restricted Gaussian-measurement cost remains a separate classification problem.

problems.title: Secret-key capacity of thermal attenuators and amplifiers
problems.summary: Secret-key capacity is distinguished from unassisted quantum capacity. Exact boundary cases and two-way bounds are recorded.

problems.title: Two-way quantum capacity of a thermal amplifier
problems.summary: Two-way quantum capacity is kept separate from secret-key capacity. Positivity theorems do not determine its general value.

problems.title: Secret-key capacity of thermal attenuators and amplifiers
problems.summary: Reverse Gaussian teleportation makes this unconstrained secret-key capacity equal to that of the reciprocal thermal attenuator. Both formulations are consolidated in the record for review problem 36; the operational reduction is stated as an editorial deduction.

problems.title: Quantum capacity of a bosonic thermal attenuator
problems.summary: This is the existing thermal-attenuator quantum-capacity question. Its permanent identity is preserved; the capacity definition and evidence locators are clarified.

problems.title: Unassisted quantum capacity of a thermal amplifier
problems.summary: The sharper antidegradable zero region and degradable-extension bounds are included. They leave the general unassisted value open.

problems.title: Permanent-of-Gaussians Conjecture
problems.summary: This hardness formulation is equivalent to the existing Gaussian-permanent conjecture using the proved anticoncentration result. The canonical record is updated.

problems.title: Permanent anticoncentration for complex Gaussian matrices
problems.summary: The July 2026 Koehler–Leung preprint resolves complex Gaussian permanent anticoncentration. Its publication status is distinguished from peer review.

problems.title: Fully polynomial sampling of boson sampling with constant photon transmission
problems.summary: Vanishing-transmission simulation results do not settle the fixed-transmission, arbitrary-accuracy sampling question.

problems.title: Average-case additive hardness of squared complex Gaussian hafnians
problems.summary: The average-case squared-hafnian estimation target and finite-precision encoding are fixed. Worst-case hardness does not settle this question.

problems.title: Anticoncentration of independent complex Gaussian hafnians
problems.summary: The September 2026 real-hafnian result does not settle the circular-complex ensemble in the statement.

problems.title: Universality of arbitrary self-adjoint polynomial Hamiltonians
problems.summary: Polynomial approximation and the self-adjointness qualification are audited. Any additional operator-theoretic deduction is identified separately from the source theorem.

problems.title: Universality of every fixed non-Gaussian polynomial generator
problems.summary: The nonlinear resource and energy-constrained approximation model are fixed. Algebraic generation is distinguished from the analytic approximation statement.

problems.title: Compact-time validity of the rotating wave approximation
problems.summary: The rotating-wave limit is strong and uniform on bounded time intervals. It is not a uniform operator-norm claim over arbitrary energy.

problems.title: Strict stationary squeezing limit for one-mode thermal diffusion
problems.summary: The stable one-mode thermal diffusion bound follows from the Lyapunov trace identity. Sharpness is an unattained infimum at instability.

problems.title: Gaussian-input preservation under a Gaussian reference extension
problems.summary: A one-photon effect followed by vacuum preparation disproves reference-extended Gaussian preservation. The trace-preserving theorem is a separate positive result.

problems.title: Wigner entropy conjecture
problems.summary: The latest purity and beam-splitter subclasses are included. Relaxed phase-space extremizers are not treated as physical counterexamples.
